description: Resolve a pending answered question: action 'record' if it changes behaviour a user or QA can see (fields override the captured values), otherwise 'dismiss'.

approver.description: Only if the user explicitly named who approved it. Never guess.

question.description: What needed deciding, e.g. 'Discount before or after tax?'

supersedes.description: Ids of older decisions this replaces

ticket.description: Ticket key; defaults to the key in the branch name

type.description: decision (default), assumption (you assumed it without asking), or impact

name: resolve_pending
